eyebrow: From a score to a probability

code:
clf = LogisticRegression()
clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
print(clf.intercept_.round(2),
      clf.coef_.round(3))

# [2.35] [[-0.107]]
# more tenure -> lower churn score
caption: L2 regularization is on by default (parameter C).

code:
clf.predict_proba([[6], [36]])
# [[0.15 0.85]   6 months
#  [0.82 0.18]]  36 months

accuracy_score(y_te, clf.predict(X_te))
# 0.79
# confusion matrix [[52  9]
#                   [12 27]]
caption: Columns are P(stay), then P(churn).

code:
xs = np.linspace(1, 60, 100)
xs = xs.reshape(-1, 1)
plt.scatter(X_tr, y_tr, s=12, alpha=0.4)
plt.plot(xs, clf.predict_proba(xs)[:, 1],
         color="crimson")
plt.axhline(0.5, linestyle="--",
            color="gray")
plt.show()
caption: The dashed line is the 0.5 decision threshold.
Predicted churn probability falls with tenure; illustrative data.
